built_by: tools/assets/trees/pack.py and sprays.py (textures only; the trees are grown by game/render/world/conifer.ts and broadleaf.ts). bark-height.jpg is the displacement map, high-passed and levelled (see pack.py).

assets.used: pine/: twig atlas (needle sprays) and bark (colour, normal, roughness, height)
spruce/: twig atlas (needle sprays) and bark (colour, normal, roughness, height)
oak/: leaf sprays composed from the scanned English oak leaves
birch/: leaf sprays composed from the scanned deltoid leaves

note: pine/ and spruce/ come from Poly Haven; oak/ and birch/ leaf sprays are composed from ambientCG leaf scans (provider per asset).
